column1: In every age, there have always been those who seek to lie about the past and distort the truth for their own gain. But let me tell you, we’re not going to let that happen. We’re going to stand strong, fight back, and make sure the real story is told. The American people deserve the truth, and we’re going to deliver it. Believe me, we’re going to win like never before. It’s going to be huge.

Before turning to the topic at hand, I want to provide a brief update on our incredible progress in securing the border. It’s absolutely fantastic, folks. We’ve built more wall than anyone thought possible, and it’s the most beautiful, sturdy, and effective wall you’ve ever seen. The numbers are staggering—hundreds of miles completed, with even more on the way. Crime is down, safety is up, and our country is stronger because of it. Believe me, no one does it better.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the economy worse, they say. But let me tell you, we’ve got the best people, the smartest people, working on this. We’re going to turn it around, and we’re going to do it fast. Nobody thought we could do what we’ve already done, but we did it. And now, we’re going to do even more. Believe me, it’s going to be huge.

It is time for North Korea to realize that the denuclearization is its only acceptable path forward. We’ve made tremendous progress, more than anyone thought possible, but there’s still so much to do. I’ve spoken with Chairman Kim, and he knows where we stand. The world is watching, and they see what we’re accomplishing. North Korea has a chance to be great, but they must act now. The alternatives are not good—trust me, they’re not good at all. We’re ready to help, but the ball is in their court. It’s a big moment, a historic moment, and I believe they’ll make the right choice. The pressure is on, and they know it. They have to decide—denuclearization or isolation. It’s that simple. And let me tell you, we’re not going to wait forever. The clock is ticking, and they know it.

And then now the next slide is a nine-city roll-up. And so to save a lot of time, because time is of the essence here, we’re looking at the data from these nine cities—big cities, important cities, cities that really matter. We’re seeing some of the best numbers we’ve ever seen, and I mean that. Tremendous progress, incredible results. And, you know, the people in these cities, they’re working hard, they’re making it happen, and we’re very proud of them.
